biggest_catch: Scribie has TEMPORARILY PAUSED hiring freelance transcribers (announcement on the official page, migrating to Scribie.ai) — you may not be able to start at all right now. Even when open, pay is per AUDIO hour: beginners effectively earn well under $1/hour of real work.
catches: TEMPORARY HIRING PAUSE: the official page announces freelance transcriber hiring is paused during migration to Scribie.ai — no new applicants accepted until the new process is announced.
Pay is per AUDIO hour ($5-$20), not per work hour — a 6-minute file can take 30-45 minutes to complete, so effective hourly pay is very low at the bottom of the range.
Zero guaranteed tasks: 'We don't assign files. You can preview and choose files to work on.'
Certification/test required before any paid work — unpaid test.
Catalog claim '$20' is the TOP of the official $5-$20/audio-hour range; beginners start at the bottom.
The job now involves correcting AI-generated transcripts rather than pure transcription — output quality and pay depend on the AI draft.

steps: Go to https://scribie.com/freelance-transcription and check whether the hiring pause has lifted (it was paused during migration to Scribie.ai).
Start the free trial — no credit card required — and complete the certification process.
Once certified, preview and choose ~6-minute transcription/review files (files are never assigned).
Correct the provided automated transcript using the transcription guide.
Earnings accumulate in your account; withdraw to your verified PayPal account with no withdrawal limits.
